text:
maria (ACME): Hey team, we noticed promo GEN-2025-50 (applied Apr 4) was supposed to be for completions only, but our invoice shows it getting consumed by embedding requests. Dashboard still shows ~50 credits left, but billing applied them to last invoice. Can someone check? Example request ids: r_01G8X1A9, r_01G8X1B0.

jess (Support): sorry to hear that — can you confirm org id and the time window? I can escalate. :eyes:

maria (ACME): org: acme-corp-123, timeframe: 2025-04-05 00:00 -> 2025-04-06 12:00 UTC. We'll paste a minimal repro below — we only used embeddings during that window.

maria (ACME): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","input":"some text"}'
```

jess (Support): thanks. escalating to billing now. alex, can you take a look at whether promo scoping was respected? tagging billing-bot for ledger extracts. @alex (Billing)

alex (Billing): looking. pulling metering logs for acme-corp-123 and those request ids. initial quick check: the meter records for those request ids show product_label = "text" (legacy mapping). If promo scope matched "completions/text" it would have applied.

mike (Engineering): hm — embeddings pipeline currently emits category "text.embedding" but our billing normalizer has a rule that collapses "text.*" into "text" (for legacy reasons). That means promos targeted to "completions" could match.

sam (Product): that sounds like a scoping mismatch. Promo GEN-2025-50 was explicitly marketed as "completions only" (internal promo metadata scope=completions). If embeddings are being normalized into text, that's a bug.

alex (Billing): proposed remediation: 1) stop-gap: change billing rule to not collapse text.embedding into text (patch today), 2) retro: run a ledger correction to move consumed promo tokens back to the promo bucket and issue credit memo for the invoice lines affected. Need confirmation of exact request ids + time range.

jess (Support): maria — can you confirm the two request ids above are representative and if there are more we should include? Also confirm whether you made any completion calls in that window.

maria (ACME): we were running a batch of only embeddings. I exported our outbound logs and attached a small sample — ~220 calls between 04-05 00:00 and 04-05 02:30 UTC. The two ids I pasted are examples. Please go ahead with the fix and the ledger correction.

alex (Billing): copying steps I'll run: 1) identify meter events for org acme-corp-123 in window 2025-04-05T00:00:00Z -> 2025-04-06T12:00:00Z where product_label was normalized to "text" but original metadata indicates "embedding"; 2) compute promo tokens consumed and reverse those by applying a credit adjustment; 3) create credit memo and update invoice; 4) PM/Support will confirm with customer.

mike (Engineering): I'll open a quick PR to change the normalizer mapping and add a unit test that ensures "text.embedding" does not alias to "text". I'll try to get the patch out in the 4pm deploy.

sam (Product): add an e2e test in the billing test harness to cover promo scoping across "completions" vs "embeddings". I'll own the test case.

alex (Billing): running ledger scan now. Will post a runbook snippet and the affected token counts.

billing-bot: ledger-scan job queued: job_id=ledg-20250405-7743, estimated time ~2m.

alex (Billing): result: found 218 embedding events that consumed promo GEN-2025-50; total promo tokens deducted = 9,860. I'll create a credit memo for 9,860 promo tokens and mark the invoice line as adjusted. Posting PR to accounting queue now.

maria (ACME): that's great, thank you. ETA on when the credit shows on dashboard/invoice?

alex (Billing): I'll create the credit memo and target the update for the next billing refresh (should reflect within 24 hours). I'll DM accounting for expedited processing if needed.

jess (Support): closing the loop — engineering will patch the normalizer in today's deploy, billing will issue memo, product will add tests. Maria, I'll follow up once the credit shows in your billing UI. Sorry again for the noise :pray:

maria (ACME): appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
